sources.title: Claude Opus 4.1
sources.evidence: August 5, 2025 release announcement maps Claude Opus 4.1 to claude-opus-4-1-20250805, calls it an Opus 4 update, describes coding, reasoning and agentic capabilities, and reports extended-thinking and tool-use evaluations. Reopened October 27, 2026: the release calls Opus 4.1 an upgrade to Opus 4 and gives the exact dated ID; it reports no nominal total or active parameter count.

sources.title: System Card Addendum: Claude Opus 4.1
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:47 UTC and independently inspected as full extracted text. Introduction on page 4 explicitly identifies Opus 4.1 as an updated version of Opus 4 with incremental improvements. No nominal total or active parameter count is supplied anywhere in the addendum. The named predecessor is explicit, but its referenced Claude 4 card also supplies no size from which to infer a number.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: Methods explicitly include production Claude Opus 4.1. Researchers inject and record residual-stream activations across model layers; the paper discusses these Transformer-based models and attention heads. This supports Transformer structure, without establishing dense versus MoE or parameter counts. Reopened October 27, 2026: Methods Notes distinguishes production models from helpful-only variants sharing their respective pretrained bases, without identifying a numerically sized base or reporting total/active parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.1 - Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Exact 20250805 model ID; 200K context; image and text inputs, text output; reasoning and computer-use tool support. Hosted partner deployment subject to an end-user license.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.1 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Complete indexed official page, crawled within the preceding week, specifies 200,000 context, text/code/image input and text output, function calling, extended thinking, and PDF-document support via Anthropic documentation. Direct page open returned 404; this is last-documented capability evidence, not proof of endpoint operation.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial terms effective June 17, 2025 govern Anthropic API access, limit reverse engineering/duplication, and do not grant broader intellectual-property rights. Together with hosted release distribution, support proprietary classification.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official Opus 4.5 card retrieved through https://www.anthropic.com/document/claude-opus-4-5-system-card on October 27, 2026 at 10:18:49 UTC; independently searched full extracted text and inspected exact Opus 4.1 comparison columns. Table 2.3.A reports benchmark scores; tables 3.1.1 and 3.1.2 report harmless-response and refusal rates. No nominal total or activated-parameter column is present. Parameter mentions concern effort, sampling, or tool arguments, not learned-model size.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official Sonnet 4.5 card retrieved through https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-4-5-system-card on October 27, 2026; independently searched full extracted text and inspected Opus 4.1 rows. Tables 2.1.1.A and 2.1.2.A report harmless-response and refusal rates, and other comparisons report capabilities or safety results. No total or activated-parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Indexed official documentation lists claude-opus-4-1-20250805 retired from the Claude API on August 5, 2026. Historical capability claims do not imply current first-party API availability.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Parent checked the exact Claude Opus 4.1 API pricing table: it lists both 200K and 1M tiers, conflicting with retained model/provider context specifications. The pricing row alone does not establish when or on which access tier 1M was available.

sources.title: Claude 4 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:47 UTC and independently inspected, including model training/characteristics and a full-text parameter/size search. This is the predecessor card explicitly referenced by Opus 4.1. It supplies no nominal total or active parameter count for Opus 4, so the documented update relationship does not yield a numeric size for Opus 4.1. Matches for parameter and billion are tool-call arguments, evaluation prose or quoted fictional revenue, not learned-model specifications.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48 UTC and independently searched throughout for Opus 4.1 and total/active/activated parameter disclosures. No Opus 4.1 comparison entry or numeric parameter disclosure was located. Parameter mentions refer to harness or reasoning-effort settings. Focused fresh web searches on October 27 for Opus 4.1 total parameters, active parameters, billion-sized claims and the named Opus 4 predecessor likewise produced no first-party numeric count or sized lineage; secondary unknown-size entries were not treated as specifications.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family for the named Claude Opus 4 update.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total in the exact release, addendum, introspection research or later comparison cards. Anthropic explicitly identifies Opus 4.1 as an update to Opus 4, but the referenced predecessor card supplies no numeric size, so the valid lineage cannot establish a count. This null reflects absent nominal disclosure, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately on October 27: neither the exact-model evidence nor later first-party comparison tables reports an active/activated parameter count. Opus 4.5 and Sonnet 4.5 table columns are evaluation results, and the newer Opus 5.5 card supplies no Opus 4.1 entry. Activation measurements and reasoning-effort settings do not specify active parameters; no equality with a total is inferred.

architecture.note: Architecture-level inference from first-party internal-activation research explicitly including production Opus 4.1, its residual stream across layers, and Transformer/attention-head descriptions. This establishes only Transformer structure, not dense/MoE topology.

context_window.note: Official exact-version hosting documentation specifies a 200K-token context; historical model capability. A May 2026 first-party API pricing table also lists 1M. Retain the directly documented 200K specification and record the unresolved surface/tier discrepancy; pricing alone does not establish availability.

modalities.note: AWS verifies text/image to text; complete indexed Google exact-model page documents PDF input support. PDF is an accepted document format processed through text and vision, retained under the catalog's input convention.

reasoning.note: Exact release reports extended-thinking results and partner specifications explicitly support extended thinking/reasoning.

tool_call.note: Release describes tool-use evaluations; exact-model partner documentation supports function calling and computer use.

patch.description: Claude Opus model with extended thinking, coding and tool-use capabilities, released as an update to Opus 4.
patch.notes: First-party interpretability research supports Transformer structure for production Opus 4.1; dense/MoE topology and total/active parameter counts are undisclosed. Anthropic identifies it as an Opus 4 update, but publishes no nominal size for that predecessor in the cited card. The 200K context and input capabilities describe the released model; Anthropic documents retirement of this dated ID from its API on August 5, 2026. PDF input is a document format processed through text and vision. An Anthropic pricing PDF effective May 12, 2026 also lists a 1M API tier, conflicting with the retained 200K model specification; availability of that tier was not verified.

summary: Fresh parameter-only re-audit on October 27 reopened the exact release, addendum and introspection study; independently inspected freshly retrieved Claude 4, Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 5.5 cards; and searched for nominal total/active disclosures and sized lineage. Both parameter counts remain explicitly null/undisclosed. Opus 4.1 is explicitly an update to Opus 4, but no numeric predecessor size was found. Later exact-model comparison columns report evaluation results, not activated parameters. All 12 non-parameter assessments and their existing corrections are preserved.
